news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹6.35 (up from ₹5.85 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹17.1b (up 26% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹276.3m (up 8.6% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.6% (down from 1.9% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 25%. Revenue is forecast to grow 23% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 21% growth forecast for the Healthcare industry in India.

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 12%
news.body: The consensus outlook for fiscal year 2026 has been updated. 2026 EPS estimate fell from ₹32.66 to ₹28.90 per share. Revenue forecast steady at ₹64.8b. Net income forecast to grow 45% next year vs 34% growth forecast for Healthcare industry in India. Consensus price target broadly unchanged at ₹1,424. Share price was steady at ₹1,149 over the past week.

news.title: Entero Healthcare Solutions Limited (NSEI:ENTERO) completed the acquisition of 51.51% stake in Anand Chemiceutics Private Limited.
news.body:
Entero Healthcare Solutions Limited (NSEI:ENTERO) entering into a binding memorandum of understanding to acquire 51% stake in Anand Chemiceutics Private Limited for INR 2.3 billion on November 12, 2025. A cash consideration of INR 2.3 billion will be paid by Entero Healthcare Solutions Limited. As part of consideration, INR 2.3 billion is paid towards common equity of Anand Chemiceutics Private Limited. The cost of acquisition shall range between INR 2.1 billion to INR 2.3 billion for acquiring 51% stake in Anand Chemiceutics subject to adjustments for net debt.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Anand Chemiceutics Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 150 million.
